"''We better.|The stormtrooper speaking to [[Unidentified stormtrooper 2 (Imperial Complex)|another stormtrooper]] before being knocked out by [[Garazeb Orrelios]]|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''stormtrooper''' served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebel uprisings]]. He was stationed on [[Lothal]], where he and [[Unidentified stormtrooper 2 (Imperial Complex)|another stormtrooper]] were posted at the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Imperial Complex]]. During the [[siege of Lothal]], while the two troopers were having a conversation regarding whether they could find the [[Spectres]], they both bumped into the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]], who knocked them out by banging their heads together. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The stormtrooper is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voiced Admiral [[Kassius Konstantine]] and [[Captain]] [[Rex]] in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'' {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
